gloss: to hold back, to check, to stop

definitions.gloss: to hold back, to check, to stop
definitions.explanation: To prevent something from advancing, spreading, or getting worse by firmly stopping it.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}の{攻撃|こうげき}を{食|く}い{止|と}める。
examples.english: To hold back the enemy's attack.

examples.japanese: {感染|かんせん}{拡大|かくだい}を{食|く}い{止|と}める{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Measures to stop the spread of infection are needed.

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}を{最小限|さいしょうげん}に{食|く}い{止|と}めた。
examples.english: The damage was kept to a minimum.

examples.japanese: {赤字|あかじ}の{拡大|かくだい}を{何|なん}とか{食|く}い{止|と}めたい。
examples.english: I want to somehow stop the deficit from growing.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: {食|く}う (to bite/eat into) + {止|と}める (to stop) = to bite into and stop (i.e., to firmly hold in place)

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes を to mark what is being stopped or checked.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{攻撃|こうげき}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to check an attack)
・{感染|かんせん}{拡大|かくだい}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to stop the spread of infection)
・{被害|ひがい}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to prevent damage)
・{浸水|しんすい}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to stop flooding)
・{赤字|あかじ}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to check losses)

USAGE NOTE: Often used in news contexts for disasters, epidemics, military situations, and economic crises. Implies urgent action to prevent something from getting worse.

RELATED ～{止|と}める COMPOUND VERBS:
・{引|ひ}き{止|と}める - to hold back (a person)
・{押|お}し{止|と}める - to hold down, to suppress
・{呼|よ}び{止|と}める - to call out and stop someone
